result.quote: but if we sit here, we will also die.
result.reason: The key is supported, though the passage says they will die if they stay, not merely that they might. A distinct defensible answer is that going to the Arameans gives them a chance to be allowed to live. The wording is unnatural and underspecified; “Why did the men with leprosy go to the camp of the Arameans?” would be clearer.
